question: Count the total number of days from 10 April 2020 to 25 July 2020, by including both the days.
solution:
We know that: 

In an ordinary year, there are 365 days and on dividing 365 by 7,

 
• We get remainder = 1 so this extra one day is taken as odd day.

Similarly, in an leap year, there are 366 days and on dividing 366 by 7,

 
• we get remainder = 2 so this extra two days is taken as odd days.
